title: Verify Ohm's Law
subject: Physics
steps: Assemble circuit: Battery → Ammeter → Resistor. Voltmeter in parallel to resistor.
Ensure connections are tight and correct. Switch is open.
Close the switch, record voltmeter & ammeter readings.
Change resistance (if possible) and repeat readings.
Plot V vs I graph, calculate slope (resistance).
correct_outcome: Linear V-I relation. Ratio V/I remains constant for Ohmic materials.

common_mistakes.explanation: Connecting battery directly with no resistance. High current will flow, causing sparks/heat.
Voltmeter not parallel, ammeter not in series. No or wrong readings.

safety_notes: Use low voltage to avoid heating.

ai_explanations.short_circuit: High current due to missing resistance can cause wires to heat up and might result in sparks. Always place a resistor in the circuit.
ai_explanations.no_reading: Check the arrangement: Ammeter in series, Voltmeter in parallel with the resistor.
